P.text: increaseLiquidityCurrentRange() is called and passes a deadline to Uniswap V3's increaseLiquidity(); in the vulnerable version the deadline is hardcoded to block.timestamp
P.evidence_quote: The function hardcodes deadline: block.timestamp when calling Uniswap V3's increaseLiquidity().

I.text: Transactions should have expiration protection via a user-provided deadline with an explicit require(block.timestamp <= deadline_) check, following Uniswap V3's security model
I.evidence_quote: The caller provides a deadline (e.g., block.timestamp + 5 minutes).

V.text: Hardcoding deadline to block.timestamp makes Uniswap's expiration check always true, eliminating transaction expiration protection and enabling MEV bots to hold the transaction indefinitely and execute with stale pricing parameters for profit
V.evidence_quote: deadline = block.timestamp >>> Uniswap’s check block.timestamp <= deadline is always true.
